clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine Forest, Sample Ichor carries traces of necromancy and warlock sorcery. Apothecary Renferrel refined it from the fluid that sustains the Rot Hide gnolls.

Apothecary Renferrel sent Sample Ichor to the Undercity for closer study. He recovered samples from the Rot Hide gnolls and their lingering remnants, then reduced the foul liquid to its base components. His analysis showed that the ichor was made through necromantic rites woven with warlock magic. Since its craft reaches beyond simple alchemy, Renferrel sent the sample to Bethor Iceshard for divination.
